response.sql:
WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
), grouped AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         ordertune,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
         AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT g.orderslink,
       g.ordertune AS order_type,
       g.avg_rebate,
       g.avg_relative_gap,
       g.avg_rebate - b.avg_rebate AS rebate_excess
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.avg_rebate
ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The relative rebate-to-fee gap is computed for each fee record and then averaged within each group; NULLs and division by zero follow SQLite's standard AVG behavior.
